title: [P0] Whole-chain PQ qualification: authority, work, quantum mining, migration, capacity and rollback
body:
## Objective
Close **six independent** post-quantum security gates without weakening current PoN Nakamoto semantics or promoting partial component results to whole-chain PQ128. Public/production/PQ128 status remains **NO_GO** until every required gate has source-bound, independently reviewed and actually executed evidence.

### Gate A — Complete authority provenance (P0)
- Enumerate every *ordinary callable* authority path: network ingress and peer identity, account/transaction/nonce, task requester/source/lease/renewal, evaluator roster/quorum, model release/withdrawal/Hepta admission/FinalUse, Cell provider discovery and retrieval, governance, upgrade, migration, recovery and external effect.
- For each trace path record exact wire/revision, state owner, trust-root bytes, algorithm, signature verification point, replay/downgrade control, reorg handling and current production-selection status.
- Fail closed on any executable classical-only authority path after PQ-only activation. Historical/unshipped code must be explicitly separated from reachable authority.

### Gate B — Authentic PQ ownership and downgrade-safe migration (P0)
- Provision/recover an independently pinned PQ public authority **before** classical-only proofs lose authenticity.
- Version and domain-separate classical, PQ-only and true hybrid authorization. Hybrid acceptance requires every signature specified by policy; never OR a classical signature as an unconditional fallback.
- Adversarial tests: key swaps, old envelopes, altered context, nonce rollback, unclaimed/claimed overlap, retired signer, reorg replay, lost acknowledgements, source deadline and recovery after SIGFAIL.
- Current candidate: [#559](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/pull/559) native PQ tasks/claims; [#561](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/pull/561) independently pinned ML-DSA Hepta handoff V2 (focused x64/ARM native test run [41069365102](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/actions/runs/41069365102)). Neither is an activation or complete authority registry.

### Gate C — W1 proof and hash security against quantum adversary (P0)
- Freeze *full* W1 relation, all SHA256/Poseidon2/FRI/Fiat-Shamir usage, recursion, exact receipt format and no Groth16/fake/legacy fallback.
- Prove or externally assess the requested quantitative quantum-security target for pinned parameters, then run accepted positive and worst invalid proof input/resource tests on actual node intake.
- The research manifest explicitly has `pq_128_security_qualified=false`; a 14,320-second successful full Composite proof in a 4-hour profile does not qualify the 5400-second original gate. Keep original failures.
- See [#545](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/pull/545).

### Gate D — Quantum-miner/DAA economic safety (P0)
- Compare weakest legal real mining instance, legal precomputation, batch amortization, hardware advantage and reversible quantum oracle at matched *effective winning work* cost, including state/material loading, complete W1 verifier, hash, invalid trials, stopping policy, retries and publication.
- Freeze DAA/fork choice for conditional timewarp/withholding/honest-client confirmation experiments. A reversible oracle **upper** gate count is not a quantum attack **lower** bound.
- Preserve small nonzero success/failure tails and honest attacker comparisons; see [#550](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/pull/550).
- No quantum work-security claim until adversary budget and independent bound are qualified.

### Gate E — PQ network capacity & rejection cost (P0)
- Run native two-architecture, original-budget, realistic valid/invalid mixed ML-DSA workloads on ingress/State/History/recovery; record true packet/serialization/storage/WAL/GPU/CPU/RSS, p95/p99, unknown and refused requests, and exact honest completion denominator.
- Check signed key rotation, fresh anonymous identities, malformed DER/signature, key expansion DoS, complete W1 plus invalid signature/State and paid capacity exhaustion. No TPS inferred from packet slots.

### Gate F — Rollback, retirement and reorg without classic escape (P0)
- Require an **independently stored** monotonic frontier/anchor with current authenticated checkpoint/generation/key epoch; an internally self-consistent old SQLite copy must not restore spent nonce, payment, revoked key or external operation.
- Document trust assumptions for a quorum/HSM/independent witnesses; current DB alone cannot prove nonrollback. Include real process interruption/power-loss, anchored source migration and withheld/contradictory witness refusals.
- Distinguish consensual fork rollback from *already performed* irreversible effect/journal ownership and FinalUse.

## Proof-of-closure rules
Each gate needs exact main/PR HEAD/base, declared source and pinned toolchain, original commands and raw artifact digests, honest failure denominators, negative as well as positive executions, external crypto review where required, and explicit independent-operator evidence. Keep `whole_chain_post_quantum=false`, `pq_128_security_qualified=false`, and production/public activation false until every gate has positive applicable receipts. No approval by checkbox or by report text.

This tracks engineering closure and does not authorize activation, change consensus/reward rules, or reinterpret historical bytes.

## Current source-bound incremental receipts (not whole-chain acceptance)
- **Gate A/B — isolated PQ Hepta handoff:** [#561](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/pull/561) HEAD `1c5899a663037689d26bf7c31472a70d26971a8b`; native x64 and ARM64 [41069365102](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/actions/runs/41069365102): each 3/3 new ML-DSA tests, 25/25 executed historical protocol tests, original 1 ignored, fmt/Clippy/source inventory passed. **Still needs** independent PQ authority roster and ordinary Hepta Control use.
- **Gate F — external recovery witness receiving component:** [#563](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/pull/563) HEAD `14a06d040d0b124f1193ddfb1b22a23f158bc806` stacked on #561; native x64 and ARM64 [41071192569](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/actions/runs/41071192569): each 4/4 witness tests, 3/3 Handoff V2, 25/25 executed V1, strict fmt/Clippy/inventory passed. **Still needs** externally operated durable monotonic witness/HSM/quorum, PQ identity migration and live cold recovery hook. A signature alone cannot establish independent storage.
- **Gates C/D/E** remain unqualified; see existing [#545](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/pull/545), [#550](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/pull/550) and [#559](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/pull/559). No historical partial proof/test may be re-labelled as PQ128 or production activation.
